title: Early work
dek: School projects in typeface design, posters and an early phone application concept.
facts: Typeface design, posters, mobile app concept
problem: Self-directed school projects exploring type, print and interaction.
approach: Typeface work includes Juicer, shown as packaging; Stutter, a twelve-point typeface designed as a visual representation of sound and combined with perspective drawing; and Container, a type specimen built from modular bits.
A layered memory poster combines illustration and graphic systems, and a phone application concept, Task Manager, visualises how time is spent across activities as a colour-coded clock.
leadership: Her own work as a design student.
gallery: Task Manager: averages by day, week, month, year
